get_fast_rcnn_blob_names: get the list of blob names needed for Fast R-CNN training or inference
add_fast_rcnn_blobs: add training blobs to a minibatch by sampling RoIs from each image in the roidb
sample_rois: sample foreground and background RoIs from an image entry using overlap thresholds
expand_bbox_targets: expand compact bounding-box regression targets into the 4-of-4K representation used by the network
add_multilevel_rois: distribute training RoIs across different FPN levels using the level assignment heuristic
